analysis_summary.primary_recommendation: TOPOLOGY: TPS259573 (eFuse OVLO @ 5.5V) → 5V LDO (LT1761 or HT7550-3) → TPS2052B gate driver
analysis_summary.rationale: The TPS2595x3 family (OVLO-programmable eFuses) can be configured to cut VBUS at exactly 5.5V via external resistor divider. Fast 5µs OVP response protects RT1062. Paired with low-noise LDO for TPS2052B powering. High LCSC stock across both parts.
analysis_summary.secondary_option: NCP361 standalone (OVP @ 5.675V + integrated PMOS FET) if simplicity and integration preferred. Higher OVLO threshold (5.675V) acceptable if brief transients tolerated.
analysis_summary.tertiary_option: TPS25200DRVR (fixed 7.6V OVLO + 5.4V output clamp) if TPS2595 divider design deemed too complex. Simpler but less precise OVLO threshold.
analysis_summary.avoid: TPS25221, AP22653 (no OVLO protection—dangerously passive for eFuse fault scenarios). MP5030 (hiccup-mode OVP, not true OVLO cutoff; QC protocol interference).
